_about: The mapped states a work item can have (the plan, phase 1), with deferred added by ADR 0020 rule 12 (a status that means 'only with the owner' maps to deferred with its condition kept). The engine's own value unknown marks a placeholder: an id the rows refer to that nothing defines (ADR 0015).

mapped.triage: not yet looked at; nobody has decided whether it is work to do
mapped.backlog: accepted work, not yet ready to start
mapped.ready: ready to start; nothing blocks it
mapped.in-review: done by its author, waiting for review or verification
mapped.cancelled: will not be done: dropped, declined or superseded
mapped.deferred: deliberately put off, or allowed only under a condition (with the owner, after a release); the condition is kept with the item

engine.unknown: an id that rows refer to but nothing defines: a placeholder (ADR 0015)

words._about: Words a ledger uses that the engine maps by rule when the repository's own legend and a person's answer say nothing (ADR 0020 rule 12); the word's own question is still asked once, so a person can correct it.
